record.endpoint_type: actual passenger reopening at Ras Jedir; Dhehiba formal availability
record.movement: Ordinary passengers and commercial vehicles restricted; category and directional exceptions documented

record.enforcement: Formal closure or reported non-operation; permeability not systematically measured
record.status_observation: Historical episode; status at 2026-10-21 not inferred

record.context: July8 announcement differs from July9 operational testimony. August Libyan reopening announcement did not establish bilateral access. September17 passengers observed at Ras Jedir; Dhehiba formally available but no passengers yet in Anadolu morning report.
